_om: UI strings and field names in English. Numbers never live here - they live in data/robots/*.yaml. A missing key fails the build. This is the only place English UI text lives: the generator’s fallback files were retired on 21 Aug 2026.
sted_undertitel: A reference work with a source and a date on every number
ingen_forhandler: We do not resell any robot on this site, and we take no payment from the manufacturers.
billednote_tekst: This site shows no manufacturer images. We hold no written permission, and a press photo is the strongest possible signal of a dealer relationship that does not exist. The slots stay empty until we have our own photographs or scale-true silhouettes.
forside_lede: {n} models from {p} manufacturers. Every figure carries a source and a retrieval date, and every gap is as visible as the figure.
forside_ordning: Ordered by weight, because weight is measured and unambiguous. Intended use is a filter, not an axis.
forside_soeg_etiket: Search by model, manufacturer or requirement
forside_soeg_pladsholder: e.g. Spot, DEEP Robotics or IP67
soeg_kraever_js: The search field requires JavaScript and is shown only when it is enabled. The filters work without it.
katalog_uden_js: The filters need JavaScript. The full catalogue is in the table below either way.
filter_uden_js: The filters are ordinary checkboxes and work without JavaScript. Several ticks in one group widen the selection; ticks in different groups narrow it.
vaegtklasse_forklaring: The class boundaries are set in the build, not in the data. The manufacturer’s own qualifier stays with the figure: a robot stated as at most 20 kg sits in 20-40 kg, because 20 is the number the manufacturer prints.
vaegtklasse_ikke_oplyst_forklaring: The manufacturer states no weight at all. These sit here, not hidden at the bottom of another class.
vaegtklasse_afledt: Derived from the stated unladen weight. The manufacturer does not state a class.
vaegtklasse_graense: the figure sits on the class boundary, and the manufacturer’s qualifier could move it
noegletal_titel: Key figures as stated by the manufacturer
noegletal_intet: The manufacturer states none of the six key figures.
noegletal_intet_alle: The manufacturer states none of the {b} key figures.
noegletal_intet_grund: The cells are not empty by mistake. There is no manufacturer page carrying the figures.
tilstand_ikke_oplyst_forklaring: The manufacturer states nothing about this field.
tilstand_nej_forklaring: The manufacturer states that the robot does not have this.
tilstand_nul_forklaring: The manufacturer states the value zero. That is a measured number, not an empty field.
tilstand_kun_billede_forklaring: The information can be seen in the manufacturer’s photo but is written nowhere.
foraeldet: Retrieved more than 12 months ago - may be wrong now.
kilder_forklaring: One line per source, not per figure: a source has one retrieval date. The letter beside a figure points to the line it came from.
kilde_maerke_forklaring: A superscript letter after a figure points to the source the figure came from. Robots with several sources carry several letters.
kilde_sek_forklaring: A dashed letter marks a secondary source on the manufacturer’s own domain - a datasheet, manual or developer documentation, not the product page.
kilde_antal_en: The three figures on this card come from 1 source
kilde_antal_flere: The three figures on this card come from {n} sources - see the marks
kort_kilder_en: The figures on this card come from 1 source
kort_kilder_flere: The figures on this card come from {n} sources - see the marks
kort_kilder_ingen: None of the figures on this card carry a source in the data file.
imperial_forklaring: The manufacturer’s own imperial figure. We do not convert.
taethed_forklaring: How many of the schema’s fields the manufacturer states itself. It measures the manufacturer’s openness, not the robot’s quality.
taethed_naevner_aaben: The denominator is not settled (D7). Both numbers are shown.
sammenlign_advarsel: Stair step and payload each exist in two variants. Only compare fields with the same label.
anvendelse_forklaring: This category is not our assessment. It is the manufacturer’s own classification, quoted verbatim. Where the manufacturer cannot be quoted, it reads not stated.
anvendelse_arvet_fra: Category inherited from the base model
anvendelse_arvet_forklaring: The manufacturer says nothing about this edition. The quote below is the base model’s, and the link between the two is ours.
anvendelse_forklaring_arvet: The words are the manufacturer’s, but they were written about the base model. That they also cover this edition is our inference — which is why it is marked.
eu_forklaring: The column shows only what the manufacturer states about CE and about availability in the EU. It is a record of fact, not import advice.
eu_ce_nej: The manufacturer states that there is no CE marking
eu_tilgaengelig_ja: Stated as available in the EU
eu_tilgaengelig_nej: Not stated as available in the EU
eu_pointe: {n} of {m} manufacturers say nothing about CE. The silence is the finding - it is not a gap in our collection.
eu_kolonne_forklaring: The column reproduces only the manufacturer’s own statements. An empty cell means the manufacturer says nothing - not that the answer is no.
eu_kolonne_tom: The manufacturer states nothing about the EU for any of its models.
eu_ce_ingen: None of the {n} models state CE.
varianter_forklaring: The manufacturer sells this model in several variants. The figures on this page apply to the variant the source names.
produktside_forklaring: We are not a dealer. The link goes to the manufacturer so the figures above can be checked at the source.
produktside_ingen: The manufacturer has no product page for this model, or it has been taken down.
robotside_midlertidig: This page is built with the generator’s temporary robot template. The real template is being written.
producent_ingen_modeller: No models from this manufacturer are in the catalogue yet.
billede_delt_forklaring: Same file as {model}. The manufacturer’s own choice - the photo is not necessarily this model.
billede_ingen_egen: We have not photographed this model ourselves, and the manufacturer’s own image may not be built into the site.
billede_ingen_grund: We have not photographed this model ourselves, and the manufacturer’s own image may not be built into the site.
